completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve a FIELD WHERE SPELLS CAN BE CAST WITHOUT EXPENDING RP; Core Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Define area,duration/concentration,eligible casters and spells,cast count or finite capacity if NEW,and exact payment timing. Preserve a substantive RP waiver while distinguishing other class costs,consumed components,actions,concentration and access requirements. Resolve Matrix recasting,copy spells,RP-generating spells,absorbing free casts and movement across boundaries using actual cast lineage. Do not turn a waived charge into a paid-resource refund or silently deny every useful application. Any added rank/cap/use constraint must be a named balance decision,not a fabricated original source field.

sourceRecord.completeHistoricalCommonQuestionUnchange: For every selected spell, settle all operational fields: actual activation and components, legal target/range/geometry, duration and concentration, resolution/DC/save or attack, full effect clauses, scaling, repeat casting/source identity, suppression/ending, limits and class-specific rank/cost access. Preserve printed clauses and every original source. Explicitly label NEW completions; no external-game import or automatic historical alias merge.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: A field allows spells without expending RP; Action120ft/V,S,F/base21. Original Instantaneous metadata retained; NEW concentration field up to60elapsed seconds.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_geometry: Choose a perceived fixed point in120feet/line of effect; create a nonphysical10foot-radius grid-metric sphere. All actual casting bodies with positive-volume intersection and center line of effect qualify, allies/enemies/caster alike. No following/recentering/support/cover/crafting stock/leyline topology. Capture eligibility at actual cast commitment after incompatible concentration ends, before pricing; release/movement later cannot reprice paid casts.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_price: Select M02-A: waive the ordinary creditable BASE bucket and ordinary pre-Nexus extras (printed ordinary extras and Dissonance surcharge) after real class/source reductions/waivers/minima and before Nexus. This is an explicit Matrix-local waiver of those minima only; other sources retain theirs. Nexus then has0early bucket; actual later Dampening+2 and final Influence remain. Protected Barrier X/Forge cycle principal and HP/material/charge/uses are NEVER waived. Barrier receives0creditableBasePaid from a waived base; actual protectedX can still fund it. Nonspell Conduit/Forge transactions get no waiver. No-interface spells gain no fictional earlyprice; later real charges retain their exact source.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_casts: No added rank/cast-count limit. Ordinary/class/ancestry/item/Reaction spell casts with a real covered RP interface may qualify, but never gain missing acquisition, pool, component, Action/use, metamagic or concentration. A free ranked spell remains ranked for Dissonance/blocks/counters. Exact copy engines keep restrictions and real inherited uses. Ready prices at actual setup, not release. Starting a self concentration replacement removes that old Matrix before its quote, so it cannot waive itself; another owner’s surviving Matrix can waive a new Matrix. This admits useful finite renewal under actual actions/history/strain, not a claim of unbounded runtime.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_outputs: Intrinsic lawful recovery is not generically erased by waiver: Well/Kindle keep exact separate rest-use ledgers; Leyline keeps its NEW receipt ledger; Shield gets0paid-base funding from a free cast; Furnace observes actual taken damage and its finite shared cap. No Matrix refund on ending or repricing of paid history. Same-owner successful field has one source/deadline; failed replacement never resurrects displaced concentration.
